summary: Iteration 26 — Live Alerts + 24h Stream Replays end-to-end (backend + mobile 390x844 frontend). Backend pytest: 10/10 passing (GET/PUT /api/live-alerts/{handle} default/persist/404/auth, /api/live/replays listing, handle filter, unknown-handle empty, response shape with no _id, direct in-process _notify_live call confirming activity row is created when alerts are ON (and alerts_disabled_for returns the fan when OFF), watch_url helper for obs vs camera). Frontend: fan @ creator profile shows profile-live-alert-toggle ('Live alerts on'); click flips to 'Live alerts off' and persists after reload. /live shows replays-section with replay-card-obstest01 and replay-expiry-obstest01 reading '20h left'; clicking the card navigates to /watch/obstest01 where 'No recording is available' is rendered and vod-player is absent (expected — Supabase storage not configured in preview). /live?watch=obstest01 opens live-modal and strips the ?watch param from the URL. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow on either /live or /u/creator.
critical_code_review_comments: live_alerts.replays(): fetches up to 60 VODs then does per-doc live_streams.find_one + _can_watch_live in a Python loop — fine today but will scale badly. Consider $lookup or batching with $in once catalog grows.

live_alerts.replays(): status filter is {'status':'ready'} on stream_vods and requires live_streams.status=='ended'. A VOD whose live doc was deleted will be silently skipped — correct behavior but worth logging to catch orphaned VODs.

server._notify_live(): import live_alerts _la happens inside a try/except at every call; cheap but repeated. Importing once at module scope would avoid the per-event try/import overhead and the broad except that currently masks real errors (only logged at warning level).

server._notify_live(): targets include a self-check (`if t == host: continue`) but Inner Circle/follower queries already exclude the host for normal data. Harmless, but the alerts_disabled_for subtraction is done AFTER the host filter — subtracting first would be a hair cheaper on big audiences.

LiveAlertBanner auto-dismisses after 10s via setTimeout on `[live, onClose]`; if two live_started events arrive <10s apart the second one resets the timer but reuses the DOM node — fine, but there's no queue so overlapping lives from different creators would clobber one another. Minor; probably acceptable.
ReplaysSection.tsx `hoursLeft` returns ceiled hours — a VOD <1 min from expiry still displays '1h left'. For UX fidelity consider showing '<1h' or minutes under the hour.
live_alerts module stores creator_id as the resolved profile id; it never cleans up prefs when a creator is deleted. Low priority but worth a cascade on account deletion.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/backend/tests/test_live_alerts_replays.py with addopts disabled (python -m pytest -o addopts=""), otherwise pytest-xdist from pytest.ini kicks in and the ADMIN_* / step-up fixtures in conftest.py don't collide but the module imports server directly for one test (TestNotifyLiveFilter) so parallel workers could race. Running serial is cheap (~3s). The obstest01 VOD will remain fresh for ~1 day — if it ages out, re-seed by setting stream_vods.obstest01.expires_at to now+24h. Live preview still has LiveKit disabled (/api/live/start → 500) and Supabase storage disabled (no playback_url), both expected and handled by the UI.
